one_liner: Nifty gains 0.5% as metals and FMCG drive market rally.

drivers.title: VIX Decline
drivers.detail: India VIX fell to 10.35, a 21-session low.

flows_line: FIIs bought Rs 1,617.45 crore; DIIs bought Rs 2,341.46 crore.
watch_next: Watch USD Unemployment Claims at 22:00 IST tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Metal and FMCG sectors can drive market gains.
Low VIX indicates reduced market volatility.
Data gaps can obscure market drivers.
